# Retool — Retool for Startups

A 100% off coupon for one year on a monthly Team or Business plan, with a value up to $60k, followed by a 25% discount on the paid plan in the second year.

| | |
|---|---|
| **Status** | Open - apply directly |
| **Verification** | Verified — A human opened the official page and confirmed this claim. |
| **Last verified** | 2026-09-14 by [@tayyabakmal1](https://github.com/tayyabakmal1) |
| **Category** | [🛠️ Developer Tools](../categories/devtools.md) |


## What you get

| | |
|---|---|
| **Type** | discount |
| **Maximum** | $60,000 — see the vendor's exact wording below |
| **Duration** | 12 months |
| **Expiry** | The 100% off discount expires after one year. |
| **When it ends** | However, you will receive a 25% discount on your paid plan the following year. |


### Not covered

- Retool customers that have already been on a paid plan for multiple billing cycles are not eligible for the offer.
- Startups that have raised $10 million or more in total funding
- Companies founded more than 10 years ago
- Annual plans (the coupon applies to monthly Team or Business plans)

> **Stacking:** The Startup offer cannot be used in conjunction with other discounts offered by sales. Once claimed, the offer cannot be transferred to a different cloud account or self-hosted deployment.
